newsitem.title: FRANCE: Spanish PM pledges crackdown on ETA.
newsitem.headline: Spanish PM pledges crackdown on ETA.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar pledged in an interview published in Paris on Saturday to crack down on the Basque separatist group ETA, saying there was no viable alternative.
"My responsibility is to strike ETA as hard as possible and that is what I am going to do," he told the newspaper Le Monde.
The daily had asked him if he agreed with suggestions by church leaders that the government should negotiate with the guerrillas.
"No, I don't believe in it for one second. On the contrary, I think the frontal war that we are waging against the terrorists is giving good results and that no other policy is possible," Aznar said.
Bilbao Bishop Ricardo Blazquez recently offered to try to end nearly three decades of violence, echoing similar offers made by other religious leaders.
ETA injured four people with a car-bomb attack against a Civil Guard barracks on Friday, its biggest strike since August.
